head.t: Heidi Health takes decision to cut workforce by 18 percent
head.x: Heidi Health has announced the decision to cut its workforce by 18 percent globally, pointing to “difficult choices” around where to focus teams and investment. In a message from co-founder and CEO Tom Kelly, the company shared that the announcement had been made to its workforce during an “all hands”
